We apply this approach during inference to compress both prompts and intermediate decoding steps, using a rollback mechanism to substitute stored multi-token KV cache entries with their single-step surrogates. Experiments across diverse models show that the merge module can be used to reduce effective sequence length by up to 40% with minimal accuracy degradation across language modeling evaluations and downstream tasks, including question answering, summarization, commonsense reasoning, and long-form mathematical reasoning. Additional lightweight adaptation of the merge module further improves the accuracy-compression trade-off in selected settings. These results demonstrate that sequential token computation in Transformers can be effectively approximated through condensed surrogate representations that approximate the original behavior without model updating.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种通过合并模块将多个输入 token 压缩为单个替代嵌入的方法，从而在推理时缩短 Transformer 语言模型的有效序列长度，并在多种任务上以较小精度损失换取最高约 40% 的压缩率。
AI.motivation: Transformer 语言模型按 token 自回归处理序列，上下文增长使计算和缓存成本越来越高；但许多相邻 token 片段高度可预测或常作为稳定单元出现，因此其表示可能可压缩。
AI.method: 引入轻量级 merge module，将一段静态 token 嵌入动态合并为一个代理嵌入，以捕捉多个 token 的功能角色，使预训练模型无需改架构或重训练即可处理压缩输入。推理时用于压缩提示词和中间解码步骤，并通过 rollback 机制用单步代理替换 KV cache 中的多 token 条目。
AI.result: 在多种模型和任务上，该方法可将有效序列长度减少最高 40%，而在语言建模评估及问答、摘要、常识推理、长文本数学推理等下游任务中精度下降很小。对 merge module 进行轻量适配还能在部分设置中进一步改善精度与压缩的权衡。
AI.conclusion: Transformer 中的顺序 token 计算可以通过压缩代理表示有效近似，在不更新原模型的情况下逼近原始行为。

title: XLOG: A CUDA-Native Engine for Neurosymbolic Integration
summary: xlog is a CUDA-native logic programming engine integrating neural perception with deterministic Datalog, probabilistic inference, and epistemic world views through a typed frontend and provider-owned CUDA runtime. Its reasoning modes share device data planes, but their execution boundaries differ: ordinary Datalog and exact inference are host-orchestrated, while certified resident recursive and Monte Carlo sampled cores record zero tracked host-device transfers before a bounded terminal receipt. The probabilistic path supports end-to-end gradients through GPU knowledge compilation from provenance to CNF to Decision-DNNF, exact weighted model counting, and backward gradients. A final smoothed circuit is certified against its source formula before caching or evaluation. Circuit caching yields a 2.74x MNIST-addition training speedup; a worst-case-optimal join subsystem yields a 27.96x geometric-mean gain over xlog's binary-join baseline. MNIST-addition accuracy matches Scallop's (0.9561 versus 0.9468), but no per-epoch speed claim is made because baseline epoch time varies with CPU quota. In five hub-skewed triangle-counting cases, the Souffle-to-fused-xlog execution-time ratio rises from 0.88x at 150k edges, where Souffle is faster, to 5.54x at 1.2M; fused peak device allocations are 85-1,033 MB versus 3,287-44,979 MB for the materializing arm. Exact inference is correctness-equivalent to but slower than ProbLog2. On a public video benchmark, a proximity predicate trained only through symbolic credit replaces hand-set geometry at unchanged held-out accuracy; within Event-Calculus rule search it fails ten-fold cross-validation and does not transfer on a leak-free split. On a maritime corpus, weighted clauses beat crisp selection by 0.065 F1, with the result reproduced by one chronological training pass.

AI.tldr: xlog 是一个 CUDA 原生的逻辑编程引擎，统一了神经感知、确定性 Datalog、概率推断和认知世界观，支持 GPU 上的概率推理与端到端梯度，并在多个任务上与 Scallop、Souffle、ProbLog2 等基线比较。
AI.motivation: 现有神经符号与逻辑推理系统往往难以同时兼顾神经感知、确定性/概率推理、认知语义和 GPU 高效执行，且执行边界、设备传输与正确性认证不够明确。
AI.method: 提出 xlog：带类型前端、provider 自有 CUDA runtime、共享设备数据平面；普通 Datalog 和精确推断由主机编排，认证驻留递归和 Monte Carlo 采样核在最终回执前记录零主机-设备传输；概率路径经 GPU 知识编译 provenance→CNF→Decision-DNNF，支持精确加权模型计数和反向梯度，平滑电路在缓存/求值前对源公式认证；使用电路缓存和最坏情况最优连接；实验涵盖 MNIST 加法、三角形计数、ProbLog2、视频基准、Event-Calculus 规则搜索和海事语料。
AI.result: 电路缓存带来 2.74x MNIST 加法训练加速；最坏情况最优连接相对 xlog 二值连接基线几何平均提升 27.96x；MNIST 加法准确率与 Scallop 相当（0.9561 对 0.9468）。五个 hub-skewed 三角形计数中，Souffle 与 fused-xlog 执行时间比从 150k 边的 0.88x 升至 1.2M 边的 5.54x；融合峰值设备分配 85-1,033 MB，物化版本为 3,287-44,979 MB。精确推断与 ProbLog2 正确性等价但更慢。视频基准中，仅通过符号信用训练的 proximity 谓词在保持准确率下替代手工几何；Event-Calculus 规则搜索十分交叉验证失败且 leak-free 划分不迁移。海事语料中加权子句比 crisp selection 高 0.065 F1，单次按时间训练可复现。
AI.conclusion: xlog 能在 GPU 上统一神经符号与概率逻辑推理，并在缓存、连接和部分应用中取得显著性能与准确率优势，同时支持认证式设备驻留执行；但其精确推断仍慢于 ProbLog2，规则搜索迁移性有限，整体收益因任务而异。

title: EnSIMem: Entity-Structured Indexing for Long-Term Agent Memory
summary: An agent that interacts with users over long periods must recall facts, preferences, events, and changes from a continuously growing interaction history. Existing memory systems often compress interactions into generic summaries or retrieve anonymous text chunks, making it difficult for an agent to identify the correct entity, property, and supporting evidence. We present EnSIMem, an entity-structured long-term memory architecture for an agent. During offline construction, the system organizes interactions into theme-coherent episodes and builds dialogue-grounded index entries of the form [entity][entity type][property:value]. Each entry preserves its source turns, temporal information, and available multimodal fields. During online interaction, the agent's request is decomposed into evidence requirements whose properties are aligned with the memory index. Entity-property lookup and adaptive retrieval then collect the evidence needed for point, temporal, compositional, and aggregation reasoning. The agent generates its response from the preserved source evidence rather than from lossy memory summaries. On long-term agent-memory benchmarks, EnSIMem achieves high answer accuracy while maintaining compact contexts and favorable online efficiency. These results show that entity-structured indexing and episode-level provenance provide a reliable foundation for long-term memory in agents. The code of our model is available at https://github.com/RamonMeng/EnSIMem.

AI.tldr: 提出 EnSIMem，一种面向智能体的实体结构化长期记忆架构：离线将交互组织为主题连贯的情节，并构建[实体][实体类型][属性:值]索引；在线将请求分解为证据需求并进行实体-属性查找与自适应检索，从而基于原始证据生成回答，提升长期记忆问答的准确率与效率。
AI.motivation: 长期交互的智能体需要记住事实、偏好、事件及其变化。现有记忆系统常将交互压缩为通用摘要或检索匿名文本块，导致难以识别正确实体、属性及支撑证据。
AI.method: 离线构建阶段，将交互组织为主题连贯的 episode，并建立基于对话的索引项 [entity][entity type][property:value]，保留源对话轮次、时间信息和可用的多模态字段。在线交互阶段，将智能体请求分解为证据需求，使其属性与记忆索引对齐，再通过实体-属性查找和自适应检索收集证据，支持点、时间、组合和聚合推理，并基于保留的源证据生成回答而非有损摘要。
AI.result: 在长期智能体记忆基准上，EnSIMem 实现了较高的回答准确率，同时保持紧凑的上下文和良好的在线效率。代码已开源：https://github.com/RamonMeng/EnSIMem。
AI.conclusion: 实体结构化索引与 episode 级溯源为智能体的长期记忆提供了可靠基础。

title: UniDataAgent: An Ontology-Grounded Agent for Enterprise Question-to-Report Automation
summary: Enterprise data agents must preserve organization specific semantics, not just translate questions into queries. We present ChinaUnicom DataAgent (UniDataAgent), an ontology grounded system for reusable question-to-report analysis that separates semantic acquisition from online execution. Ontology Acquisition and Validation stage (OAV) builds versioned enterprise ontologies from metadata, business knowledge, and supporting materials through expert authored business skills, constrained generation, question verification, and selected expert review. Question-to-Report Execution (QRE) stage retrieves semantic contracts for each question, coordinates skills and data tools, validates results, and produces evidence linked reports. Across 27 enterprise tables and roughly thousands of metric types, ontology construction took a few hours instead of about one week manually. It took just a few minutes to generate the reports, instead of several working days. Ontology grounding achieved 95.0\% strict accuracy on real business questions, versus 72.5\% for document RAG, especially on structured and compositional tasks. The system has already been deployed to generate cost savings and has the potential to be replicated in other enterprises.

AI.tldr: 提出中国联通DataAgent（UniDataAgent），一个基于本体、将语义获取与在线执行分离的可复用问数到报告分析系统，在企业数据智能体场景中实现高效准确的问答分析。
AI.motivation: 企业数据智能体需保留组织特定语义，而非仅将问题转为查询；同时需要可复用、高准确率的问数到报告分析方案。
AI.method: 采用两阶段架构：本体获取与验证（OAV）通过专家编写的业务技能、受限生成、问题验证和选择性专家审核，从元数据、业务知识及支持材料构建版本化企业本体；问题到报告执行（QRE）检索语义契约、协调技能与数据工具、验证结果并生成证据链接报告。
AI.result: 在27张企业表、约数千种指标类型上，本体构建仅需数小时（人工约一周），报告生成仅需数分钟（人工需数个工作日）；本体 grounding 严格准确率达95.0%，文档RAG为72.5%，在结构化与组合任务上优势明显；系统已部署并产生成本节约。
AI.conclusion: 系统已实际部署并带来成本节约，具备在其他企业复制的潜力。

title: Meet, Compare, or Abstain: LatWeave for Deterministic Multi-Hop Question Answering on Knowledge Lattices
summary: Probabilistic question-answering systems -- whether large language models (LLMs) themselves, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or trained multi-hop retrievers -- conflate "what is known" and "how to reason" into a single probabilistic computation: hallucination cannot be eradicated, evidence chains cannot be audited, and the system answers even when it does not know. We present LatWeave, which organizes knowledge into a multidimensional knowledge lattice and compiles multi-hop QA into three deterministic operators -- meet (constraint intersection), compare (lattice-order comparison), and abstain (structural abstention); LLMs appear only on the construction side (one-shot extraction) and the query-planning side, while the answer-generation path is zero-LLM, zero-task-training, and auditable end to end -- so that question answering over Web-published knowledge becomes reproducible item by item. Rather than claiming across-the-board SOTA, we characterize the operating envelope of this paradigm on six public benchmarks: when knowledge is complete (MetaQA, 39,093 questions) meet chains are near-lossless over three hops (any-hit 0.9975, on par with fully supervised KBQA); on templated multi-hop home ground (2WikiMultihopQA held-out n=1,258) EM 0.865, well above published structure-augmented RAG reproductions; on open-text deep composition (MuSiQue) and extraction-coverage gaps (HotpotQA) we report degradation honestly and attribute it to causes outside the lattice-algebra layer; and when information is incomplete (IIRC) we achieve structural abstention with abstain accuracy 0.971 and leak rate 0.029. Within the operating envelope, deterministic execution pays no performance penalty, and every step on the answer path can be recomputed -- precisely the source of end-to-end auditability.

AI.tldr: 提出 LatWeave，将知识组织为多维知识格，并把多跳问答编译为 meet、compare、abstain 三个确定性算子；LLM 仅用于知识抽取与查询规划，答案生成路径零 LLM、零任务训练且可端到端审计。
AI.motivation: 现有概率式问答系统（LLM、RAG、训练式多跳检索器）把“知道什么”和“如何推理”混入单一概率计算，导致幻觉无法根除、证据链无法审计，并且不知道时仍会作答。
AI.method: 构建多维知识格；将多跳 QA 编译为确定性算子：meet 约束交集、compare 格序比较、abstain 结构化弃答。LLM 仅出现在构建侧（一次性抽取）和查询规划侧，答案生成路径不使用 LLM 与任务训练。
AI.result: 在六个公开基准上刻画适用边界：MetaQA（39,093 题）三跳 meet 链近乎无损，any-hit 0.9975，与全监督 KBQA 相当；2WikiMultihopQA 留出集 n=1,258 上 EM 0.865，高于已发表的结构增强 RAG 复现；MuSiQue 与 HotpotQA 上如实报告退化并归因于格代数层之外；IIRC 上结构化弃答准确率 0.971，泄漏率 0.029。
AI.conclusion: 该范式不宣称全面 SOTA，而是界定操作范围；在范围内确定性执行不带来性能损失，答案路径每步可重算，从而实现端到端可审计。

title: Ruby-ASR: Evidence-Preserving Supervision for Joint Orthographic and Lexical-Reading Recognition
summary: Conventional Japanese automatic speech recognition (ASR) is supervised by an orthographic transcript, although the same written form can correspond to different lexical readings realized in speech. Such utterances receive an identical target, so their reading distinction is absent from the supervision interface and cannot be recovered reliably by post-hoc text-only grapheme-to-phoneme conversion. We present Ruby-ASR, which refines the conventional target into a span-bound orthographic--lexical-reading sequence. Unlike separate full-sentence orthographic and phonological outputs, the ruby representation locally binds each written span to its realized reading and permits deterministic recovery of both views. We instantiate the target under subtitle-style and verbatim-style transcription conventions using a Qwen3-ASR backbone; a mora-level CTC objective provides auxiliary monotonic reading supervision. The experimental results across five Japanese benchmarks show that refining the recognition target can improve lexical-reading recovery without sacrificing readable orthographic transcription. We release the checkpoints and inference code.

AI.tldr: 提出 Ruby-ASR，将日语 ASR 的传统正交文本标注细化为「书写片段—实际读音」绑定的 ruby 序列，在 Qwen3-ASR 主干上以字幕式和逐字式两种规范实例化，并加 mora 级 CTC 辅助监督，在五个日语基准上提升了词汇读音恢复能力且不损害文本转写可读性，并开源检查点与推理代码。
AI.motivation: 传统日语 ASR 只用正交转写作为监督，但同一书写形式在语音中可能对应不同词汇读音，导致这些句子目标相同、读音差异在监督接口中缺失；事后的纯文本字素到音素转换也无法可靠恢复，因此需要让读音信息进入监督目标本身。
AI.method: 将传统目标细化为按片段绑定的「正交—词汇读音」序列（ruby 表示），可在局部把书写片段与其实际读音绑定，并能确定性还原两种视图；以 Qwen3-ASR 为主干，在字幕式与逐字式转写规范下实例化目标，并引入 mora 级 CTC 目标提供单调读音的辅助监督。
AI.result: 在五个日语基准上，细化识别目标可提升词汇读音的恢复效果，同时不牺牲可读的正交转写性能。
AI.conclusion: 将读音信息显式、局部地绑定进 ASR 监督目标，是恢复日语词汇读音的有效途径；作者开源检查点与推理代码以支持后续研究。

title: Can One Adapted Model Do It All? Fine-Tuning Strategy Selection for Customer Support LLMs
summary: Production customer-support systems often require LLMs to support multiple skills, such as intent classification, question answering, summarization, or tool-use decisions. A central deployment question is whether these skills should be handled by separate task-specialist models or by a single model trained through multi-task training, sequential updates, or model merging. We study this question using thirteen models spanning five families (Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Gemma-3, Llama-3.1, and Mistral) from 0.6B to 32B parameters across eight customer-support datasets, spanning four public and four proprietary datasets with approximately 74.5k training and 8.7k evaluation samples. Under a fixed training protocol, we train more than 200 checkpoints. Our experiments reveal that multi-task full fine-tuning is the strongest operational default at every model size we test. Specialist models are strong on their target tasks but often degrade sharply off-task, making reliable routing important. Sequential Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) preserves earlier skills better than sequential full fine-tuning, while merging a specialist with its base model improves off-task robustness with limited same-task loss for larger models. We conclude with practical guidelines for selecting fine-tuning strategies in real-world settings.

AI.tldr: 本文通过13个模型、8个客服数据集和200多个检查点的实验，系统比较了多任务全量微调、任务专家模型、顺序更新和模型合并等策略，发现多任务全量微调是各规模下最强的默认方案，并给出了实际部署中的选择指南。
AI.motivation: 生产级客服系统常需LLM支持意图分类、问答、摘要、工具使用决策等多种技能，部署时的核心问题是应使用单独的任务专家模型，还是通过多任务训练、顺序更新或模型合并来训练单一模型。
AI.method: 在固定训练协议下，使用来自5个模型家族（Qwen3、Qwen3.5、Gemma-3、Llama-3.1、Mistral）的13个模型（0.6B至32B参数），在8个客服数据集（4个公开、4个专有，约74.5k训练和8.7k评估样本）上训练超过200个检查点，对比多任务全量微调、专家模型、顺序LoRA、顺序全量微调及模型合并等策略。
AI.result: 多任务全量微调在所有测试模型规模上都是最强的操作默认方案；专家模型在目标任务上表现强，但跨任务时性能常急剧下降，因此可靠路由很重要；顺序LoRA比顺序全量微调更能保留早期技能；将专家模型与基座模型合并可提升跨任务鲁棒性，且对较大模型而言同任务性能损失有限。
AI.conclusion: 研究为真实场景中选择合适的微调策略提供了实用指南，表明多任务全量微调应作为默认选择，同时可根据对路由可靠性、技能保留和跨任务鲁棒性的需求权衡其他策略。

title: Memory Control Signals Emerge Before Action in Long Horizon Agents
summary: Long horizon language model agents continuously accumulate interaction history, increasing computational cost while making relevant information harder to preserve and reuse. Existing context management methods mainly focus on how to compress or retrieve history, but largely leave open whether the model itself already represents the need for these memory operations before they occur. We study the hidden state immediately before each agent action and find that compression and recall needs are already encoded in the model's internal representations. These signals cannot be explained by simple context length or interaction progress, and they exhibit distinct formation patterns across model depth. We further show that most memory decision information is preserved in a compact recent context, while selectively restored historical evidence complements the long range dependencies that recent context misses. Based on these findings, we propose Preaction Memory with Evidence Retrieval (PaMER), which combines state guided compression with external evidence retrieval. PaMER+ further introduces step level evidence selection to recover only the historical information required by the current task. Experiments on WorkBuddyBench, across multiple context management baselines and model backbones, show that our framework substantially reduces context consumption while maintaining competitive task performance.

AI.tldr: 论文发现长程语言模型智能体在执行动作前的隐藏状态中已编码了压缩与召回需求，据此提出PaMER（及PaMER+）框架，将状态引导的压缩与外部证据检索结合，在降低上下文消耗的同时保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体持续累积交互历史，导致计算成本上升且关键信息难以保留复用。现有上下文管理方法多关注压缩或检索本身，却未探究模型是否在记忆操作发生前就已内部表征了这种需求。
AI.method: 分析每次智能体动作前的隐藏状态，验证压缩与召回信号的存在及其随模型深度的形成模式；发现近期紧凑上下文保留大部分记忆决策信息，而选择性恢复历史证据可补充长程依赖。据此提出PaMER，将状态引导压缩与外部证据检索结合；PaMER+进一步引入步骤级证据选择，仅恢复当前任务所需的历史信息。
AI.result: 在WorkBuddyBench上，跨多种上下文管理基线和模型骨干进行实验，所提框架显著减少上下文消耗，同时保持有竞争力的任务表现。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部表征可提前预测记忆操作需求，且紧凑近期上下文与选择性历史证据互补；基于此的PaMER/PaMER+能有效优化长程智能体的上下文管理。

title: Hunyuan-A13B Technical Report
summary: We present Hunyuan-A13B, an open-source large language model based on a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. It contains 80 billion total parameters but activates only 13 billion during inference, balancing model capability, computational efficiency, and deployment cost. The model is pretrained on a rigorously filtered 20T-token corpus with enhanced STEM data curation, improving factual reliability and reasoning ability. High-quality supervised fine-tuning and large-scale reinforcement learning further enhance its overall performance. Hunyuan-A13B also introduces a dual-mode Chain-of-Thought framework that adapts reasoning depth to task complexity: fast thinking for routine queries and slow thinking for complex, multi-step problems. Evaluations show competitive performance across mathematics, science, programming, general language understanding, and agent tasks, often approaching that of much larger models. Its high inference throughput makes it suitable for latency-sensitive applications. We release Hunyuan-A13B to support open research and practical LLM deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出开源大语言模型Hunyuan-A13B，基于MoE架构，总参数80B，激活13B，引入双模式思维链，性能接近更大模型。
AI.motivation: 在模型能力、计算效率和部署成本之间取得平衡，并支持开放研究和实际LLM部署。
AI.method: 采用MoE架构；在20T token语料上预训练，增强STEM数据；进行高质量监督微调和强化学习；引入双模式思维链（快速思考与慢速思考）。
AI.result: 在数学、科学、编程、通用语言理解和智能体任务上表现有竞争力，常接近更大模型；高推理吞吐量适合延迟敏感应用。
AI.conclusion: 发布Hunyuan-A13B以支持开放研究和实际部署，实现了能力、效率与成本的平衡。

title: PotARCin: Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Skill Acquisition in Abstract Reasoning Tasks
summary: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) has become a prominent benchmark for evaluating general abstract reasoning and fluid intelligence in AI models. Yet standard ARC evaluation considers only a single capability: producing the correct output grid for a test input. We argue that this narrow format fails to evaluate the diversity of abilities that genuine abstract skill acquisition should enable. We introduce PotARCin, a benchmark that extends ARC by assessing understanding of a task's underlying abstract rule across five dimensions: Definition, Classification, Constrained Generation, Editing, and Inversion. PotARCin employs programmatic methods to generate new task instances and transform given inputs for a given ARC task, enabling dynamic generative sampling beyond fixed input-output pairs. Across five state-of-the-art models evaluated on the ARC-AGI-1 training set, we observe a 25-52 percentage-point performance gap between standard ARC evaluation and evaluation on PotARCin, and find that multi-dimensional evaluation reorders models that standard accuracy ranks alike. We further investigate effects of generative sampling, difficulty of corruption types, and questions of self-consistency, showing that models frequently contradict their own formalized rule even where they have stated it correctly. We also introduce P-ARC, a held-out hand-crafted test set, on which models achieve 1-8% accuracy across all five dimensions, underscoring the importance of more holistic evaluations of abstract reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PotARCin基准，将ARC评估扩展为五个维度（定义、分类、约束生成、编辑、反转），以评估对抽象规则的理解。实验发现标准ARC评估与PotARCin之间存在25-52个百分点的性能差距，且多维评估会改变模型排名。此外还引入了P-ARC测试集，模型在所有维度上准确率仅1-8%。
AI.motivation: 标准ARC评估仅考虑单一能力：为测试输入生成正确的输出网格。这种狭窄的格式无法评估真正的抽象技能习得所应具备的多样化能力。
AI.method: 提出PotARCin基准，通过程序化方法为给定ARC任务生成新任务实例并转换输入，实现动态生成采样，超越固定的输入-输出对。在ARC-AGI-1训练集上评估五个最先进模型，并研究生成采样、损坏类型难度及自洽性问题。还引入了手工制作的留出测试集P-ARC。
AI.result: 标准ARC评估与PotARCin评估之间存在25-52个百分点的性能差距；多维评估会重新排序标准准确率排名相近的模型。模型经常在已正确陈述形式化规则的情况下仍自相矛盾。在P-ARC上，模型在全部五个维度上的准确率仅为1-8%。
AI.conclusion: 需要对抽象推理能力进行更全面的评估，标准ARC评估不足以衡量真正的抽象推理技能。

title: Guides That Cause Actions: An Offline Study of Guide-Action Mutual Reinforcement in Multimodal Web Agents
summary: Web agents are usually evaluated in live environments, where environment state and judge models drift between runs, so the same checkpoint rarely reproduces the same score, making controlled studies of training phenomena impractical. We present WebMRE, an offline benchmark of 541 tasks and 5,293 steps derived from successful WebArena trajectories, with fully audited test labels and a deterministic protocol that scores a checkpoint identically on every run without any environment. Each step pairs a human oriented guide sentence with a grounded action, enabling the first study of the mutual reinforcement effect between them in web agents. Averaged over three seeds the effect holds for both models in both decoding orders and grows with scale: jointly decoding a guide lifts element selection over an action only reference by 0.9 and 0.2 points for Qwen3.5-4B and by 1.7 and 2.2 points for Qwen3.5-9B. A mediation analysis shows that the guide is a causal channel rather than commentary: forcing the gold guide as a decoding prefix lifts action accuracy from .422 to .684, another step's guide collapses it to .055, and a paraphrase that renames the target still recovers half of the gain, so the channel carries instruction meaning and not only the label string. The same channel yields an offline reward that only a replayable protocol makes computable, though optimizing it from a strong checkpoint brings no gain yet. Our fine tuned models outperform GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, and Gemini 3.5 Flash, run zero shot, on every offline metric.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WebMRE，一个基于WebArena成功轨迹构建的离线基准（541个任务、5293步），具备完整测试标签与确定性评测协议，可零环境复现得分，并首次研究了网络智能体中引导句与动作之间的相互增强效应。
AI.motivation: 现有网络智能体多在真实环境中评测，环境状态与评判模型在多次运行间漂移，导致同一检查点难以复现相同分数，使训练现象的受控研究难以开展。
AI.method: 构建离线基准WebMRE，从成功WebArena轨迹中提取任务与步骤，每步配对人类引导句与落地动作；采用确定性评测协议，无需环境即可复现分数；开展相互增强效应实验、中介分析（强制金引导前缀、替换为其他步骤引导、改写目标名称），并微调模型。
AI.result: 三个随机种子平均下，联合解码引导在两种模型和两种解码顺序中均提升元素选择，且随规模增长：Qwen3.5-4B提升0.9与0.2分，Qwen3.5-9B提升1.7与2.2分。中介分析表明引导是因果通道：强制金引导前缀使动作准确率从0.422升至0.684；换用其他步骤引导则骤降至0.055；改写目标名称仍可恢复约一半增益。离线奖励仅靠可重放协议才可计算，但从强检查点优化该奖励暂无收益。微调模型在零样本下于所有离线指标上超越GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8和Gemini 3.5 Flash。
AI.conclusion: 引导句是承载指令含义的因果通道而非单纯注释，网络智能体存在引导与动作的相互增强效应；可重放的离线协议使受控、可复现的训练现象研究成为可能。

title: Automated Extraction of Records of Processing Activities (RoPA) Using Hybrid RAG and Locally Deployed Large Language Models
comment: English version followed by Vietnamese version. Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 29th National Conference on Selected Issues of Information and Communication Technology (VNICT 2026), Hanoi, Vietnam, November 7-8, 2026
summary: Vietnam's Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 91/2025/QH15) and Decree No. 356/2025/ND-CP, effective January 1, 2026, require organizations to establish and maintain Records of Processing Activities (RoPA). Manual RoPA preparation is labor-intensive, while cloud-hosted large language models (LLMs) may conflict with data-sovereignty requirements. We propose RoPA Manager, a system for automated RoPA information extraction using hybrid retrieval that combines lexical ranking over tsvector, dense-vector search, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), and locally deployed LLMs. We introduce a Vietnamese RoPA benchmark with 32 organizations, 77 processing activities, 12 field groups, and 4,338 reference values. Evaluation is reported at three distinct levels. The automated scorer, tested on perturbed data without invoking an LLM, achieved F1 = 0.9493 [0.9436, 0.9548]; this measures scorer robustness rather than end-to-end extraction accuracy. End-to-end extraction achieved token coverage of 50.04-55.25% against the reference labels. Two independent experts reviewed 1,558 reference values (35.9% of the benchmark), found no incorrect values, and achieved 99.68% agreement with PABAK = 0.9936. Value-level precision was not measured. Across 32 paired scenarios on a 24 GB GPU, locally deployed Qwen3.5-27B-GPTQ-Int4 showed no statistically significant difference from cloud-based DeepSeek-V4-Flash (difference 0.20 percentage points in favor of DeepSeek, 95% CI [-0.93, 1.32], p = 0.72), while Gemma-4-31B performed significantly worse (p < 0.01).

AI.tldr: 针对越南《个人数据保护法》及第356/2025/ND-CP号法令要求的处理活动记录（RoPA），论文提出 RoPA Manager 系统，采用词法检索、稠密向量检索、RRF 融合与本地部署大模型实现自动化 RoPA 信息抽取，并构建越南语 RoPA 基准进行三层评估。
AI.motivation: 越南法律要求组织建立并维护 RoPA，手工编制耗时费力；而云端大模型可能违反数据主权要求，因此需要一种自动化且可本地部署的 RoPA 信息抽取方案。
AI.method: 提出 RoPA Manager：结合 tsvector 词法排序、稠密向量搜索、Reciprocal Rank Fusion（RRF）与本地部署 LLM 的混合检索抽取系统；构建越南语 RoPA 基准，含 32 个组织、77 项处理活动、12 个字段组和 4,338 个参考值；从三层进行评估，并比较本地与云端模型。
AI.result: 自动评分器在扰动数据上 F1=0.9493 [0.9436, 0.9548]；端到端抽取相对参考标签的 token 覆盖率为 50.04–55.25%；两位专家复核 1,558 个参考值（占基准 35.9%），未发现错误值，一致率 99.68%，PABAK=0.9936，但未测量值级精确率；在 24 GB GPU 上，本地 Qwen3.5-27B-GPTQ-Int4 与云端 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 差异不显著（DeepSeek 高 0.20 个百分点，95% CI [-0.93, 1.32]，p=0.72），Gemma-4-31B 显著更差（p<0.01）。
AI.conclusion: 混合检索加本地部署 LLM 可在满足数据主权要求的前提下用于 RoPA 信息抽取，本地模型性能可与部分云端模型相当；但端到端抽取覆盖率仍有限，且值级精确率尚未测量，需谨慎解读实际抽取准确性。

title: Neither Silence nor Overlap Is Failure: Intent-Conditioned Evaluation of Turn-Taking in Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Models
summary: Benchmarks for full-duplex spoken dialogue models score turn-taking with binary fixed-window rules that reward immediate response or silence by completeness of the prior turn. We argue that the appropriateness of a response offset, whether delayed silence or anticipatory overlap, is conditional on the speaker's latent intent, identifiable only from that speaker's behavior. We introduce TACT, a benchmark of 9,728 episodes and 73.2 hours from five dyadic corpora; each episode carries dialogue history, a per-speaker memory profile, and an annotator-derived posterior over six intent classes. Scoring replaces binary windows with a strictly proper threshold-weighted continuous ranked probability score whose weights are intent-conditioned timing kernels fitted to human floor-transfer-offset distributions, proving boundedness, consistency, and binary reduction. Across eleven systems the best model reaches 0.47 against a human topline of 0.86, is nearly invariant to speaker profiles, and TACT agrees with human judgments at Spearman 0.81 versus 0.46 for binary metrics.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TACT 基准，用基于说话人潜在意图的条件化连续评分替代全双工口语对话模型中的二值固定窗口轮次转换评估。
AI.motivation: 现有基准用二值固定窗口规则评估轮次转换，只奖励立即回应或沉默，并以先前轮次完整性为依据，忽略了回应偏移是否合适取决于说话人潜在意图，而该意图只能从其行为中识别。
AI.method: 构建 TACT 基准，包含来自五个双人对话语料的 9,728 个片段和 73.2 小时数据；每个片段包括对话历史、每位说话人的记忆画像，以及标注者给出的六类意图后验分布。评分采用严格 proper 的阈值加权连续排序概率评分（CRPS），权重为意图条件下的时间核，并拟合人类话轮转移偏移分布，同时证明其有界性、一致性和二值退化性。
AI.result: 在十一个系统中，最佳模型得分 0.47，人类上界为 0.86；模型对说话人画像几乎不变；TACT 与人类判断的 Spearman 相关为 0.81，而二值指标仅为 0.46。
AI.conclusion: 基于意图条件的连续评分能更符合人类对轮次转换适当性的判断，优于传统二值固定窗口评估，表明全双工对话模型评估应纳入说话人意图与时间动态。

title: Large Knowledge Model: From Papers to a Scientific Reasoning Landscape
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures; under review at ICLR 2027. Website: https://lkm.bohrium.com/web/en
summary: Accumulated scientific knowledge advances inquiry when prior findings help researchers choose new questions, design investigations, and interpret results. Realizing this value at scale requires access to the reasoning that connects research problems, scientific procedures, conclusions, and evidence. We introduce the Large Knowledge Model (LKM), a scientific knowledge infrastructure that transforms the literature into a shared, computationally accessible reasoning resource. LKM represents papers as source-grounded reasoning graphs, couples structural traversal with semantic retrieval over the same objects, and aligns related questions, claims, and reasoning chains across papers. This representation forms a Scientific Reasoning Landscape with three connected views: a Question Landscape that organizes research problems and open directions, a Workflow Landscape that exposes reusable scientific procedures, and an Evidence Landscape that connects conclusions to their support, disagreement, and conditions. The unified substrate supports reasoning-aware scientific search, evidence-grounded question answering, comparative evidence analysis, and research planning. Researchers and agents can retrieve relevant work through its scientific intent, synthesize answers with inspectable supporting arguments, and develop research plans informed by established workflows and unresolved evidence. We describe a corpus-scale system and evaluate scientific retrieval and knowledge-intensive question answering. With the answering model fixed, LKM retrieval improves accuracy by 9.30%, 4.20%, and 14.69% on ChemBench, PubMedQA, and SciBench, respectively. By connecting knowledge access to scientific reasoning and action, LKM provides a common foundation for discovering relevant research, reusing scientific knowledge, and coordinating cumulative inquiry across researchers, agents, and research cycles.

AI.tldr: 提出大型知识模型（LKM），将科学文献转化为可计算的推理资源，构建包含问题、工作流和证据三个视图的科学推理景观，支持推理感知的搜索、问答和规划。
AI.motivation: 积累的科学知识能促进研究，但大规模利用其价值需要获取连接研究问题、科学过程、结论和证据的推理。
AI.method: LKM将论文表示为基于来源的推理图，结合结构遍历与语义检索，对齐跨论文的问题、主张和推理链，形成问题、工作流、证据三个景观视图，支持推理感知搜索、证据问答、比较分析和研究规划。
AI.result: 在语料规模系统上评估检索和知识密集型问答。固定问答模型时，LKM检索在ChemBench、PubMedQA和SciBench上分别提升准确率9.30%、4.20%和14.69%。
AI.conclusion: LKM连接知识获取与科学推理及行动，为发现相关研究、重用科学知识和协调跨研究者、智能体及研究周期的累积探究提供共同基础。

title: EmbodiedSWE: Coding Agents for Long Horizon Dexterous Robotics
summary: We study coding agents for long-horizon, dexterous robotics and ask whether their solutions can provide scalable supervision for learning general robot policies. To test this, we develop EMBODIEDSWE-BENCH, a simulation benchmark for coding agents spanning contact-rich manipulation, deformable objects, and long-horizon tasks requiring up to half an hour of continuous interaction. We find that frontier coding agents can solve complex long-horizon tasks and transfer prior solutions across both tasks and embodiments. We also design supporting tools that help agents more effectively solve these tasks. However, the resulting solutions require substantial iterative interaction and are typically specialized to individual task instances. We therefore introduce EMBODIEDSWE-GEN, which expands a single solution from coding agent into large diverse trajectories for training a VLA. VLA performance improves with more generated demonstrations, and agent-aided diversification improves generalization to held-out task variations. We also show that a VLA finetuned solely on coding-agent-generated simulation demonstrations completes a long-horizon task on real robot. Together, our framework uses coding agents to solve complex robotics tasks and turn verified solutions into scalable supervision for robot policies.

AI.tldr: 研究编码智能体能否解决长时程灵巧机器人任务，并将其解决方案转化为可扩展监督以训练通用机器人策略；提出EMBODIEDSWE-BENCH基准和EMBODIEDSWE-GEN数据生成框架。
AI.motivation: 长时程、接触丰富、可变形物体等机器人任务难以获得可扩展的监督数据，因此探索编码智能体能否解决这些复杂任务，并将其解转化为训练机器人策略的数据来源。
AI.method: 构建模拟基准EMBODIEDSWE-BENCH，覆盖接触丰富操作、可变形物体和长达半小时的长时程任务；评估前沿编码智能体，并设计辅助工具；提出EMBODIEDSWE-GEN，将单个智能体解决方案扩展为大量多样轨迹，用于训练VLA模型。
AI.result: 编码智能体能解决复杂长时程任务，并可跨任务与跨本体迁移，但需大量迭代且常针对特定任务实例；EMBODIEDSWE-GEN生成的演示越多，VLA性能越好，智能体辅助多样化提升对未见任务变体的泛化；仅用编码智能体生成的模拟演示微调的VLA可在真实机器人上完成长时程任务。
AI.conclusion: 该框架利用编码智能体解决复杂机器人任务，并将经验证的解决方案转化为机器人策略的可扩展监督。

title: Sparse-Observation Atmospheric Thermal Forecasting with Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Climate-Aware Digital Twins
summary: Short-horizon forecasts of atmospheric temperature are needed to support climate-aware digital-twin systems, but such forecasts must be produced where thermal observations are incomplete. This study evaluates a physics-informed neural network for potential-temperature forecasting, constrained by a pressure-coordinate thermodynamic advection-source equation and a diabatic-source closure fit from the preceding 12-hour period and frozen before future-time training. Using hourly ERA5 reanalysis at three pressure levels, the model is evaluated as a conditional hindcast at lead times of one, two and three hours against persistence, local-trend, and two matched neural-network baselines, one of which receives the same future meteorological forcing as the PINN, helping distinguish the physical constraint from access to future forcing. In an Oklahoma development case, mean RMSE improvement over the strongest baseline grew from 8.1\% at one hour to 23.8\% at three hours; under an observation-density sweep down to 5\% of candidate locations, this 3-hour advantage remained 14.6--16.9\%, with no evidence that lower density improves performance. Under a fixed protocol transferred to an Alabama heat event with three virtual-observation layouts, three-hour improvement ranged 19.7-24.4\% with consistent origin-level wins. A parallel Montana stress test, in which fixed pressure levels intersected complex terrain, produced a three-hour degradation of roughly 17.5\%, identifying a terrain-related applicability limit of the formulation. Together, these results indicate that the physics constraint's benefit grows with forecast horizon, persists under severe observation sparsity, and transfers across regions, but is bounded by the validity of a fixed vertical-coordinate representation over complex terrain, evidence relevant to physics-constrained components of climate-aware forecasting and digital-twin systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了一种物理信息神经网络（PINN）用于位温预报，在1、2、3小时提前期上优于多种基线，并在观测稀疏和跨区域场景下保持优势，但在复杂地形下受固定垂直坐标表示有效性限制。
AI.motivation: 气候感知数字孪生系统需要短时大气温度预报，但许多地点热力观测不完整，因此需要能在观测稀缺条件下工作的物理约束预报方法。
AI.method: 构建受气压坐标热力学平流源方程约束的PINN，并用前12小时拟合、在未来时段训练前冻结的非绝热源闭合；使用三个气压层的ERA5逐小时再分析数据，以1、2、3小时条件后报进行评估，对比持续性、局地趋势和两个匹配神经网络基线，其中一个基线也接收未来气象强迫，以区分物理约束与未来强迫信息的作用。
AI.result: 俄克拉荷马发展案例中，相对最强基线的平均RMSE改善从1小时的8.1%增至3小时的23.8%；观测密度降至候选位置的5%时，3小时优势仍为14.6%–16.9%，且未发现密度降低带来性能提升。阿拉巴马热事件中，三种虚拟观测布局下3小时改善为19.7%–24.4%，且各起点层面稳定获胜。蒙大拿复杂地形压力测试中，固定气压层与地形相交导致3小时性能约下降17.5%，显示地形适用性限制。
AI.conclusion: 物理约束带来的收益随预报时效增加而增大，在严重观测稀疏下仍能保持，并可跨区域迁移；但其效果受固定垂直坐标表示在复杂地形上有效性的限制，这对气候感知预报和数字孪生系统中的物理约束组件具有参考意义。

title: Attention Routing Stabilizes Early: Working-Set Inference for Recurrent Language Models
summary: Recurrent language models repeatedly apply shared network blocks to refine latent representations, but standard inference recomputes global attention at every recurrent step. We study attention dynamics across recurrent depth and find that attention support and distributions stabilize substantially earlier than hidden states and attention outputs. This suggests a two-stage structure: early steps discover a sparse working set of relevant context, while later steps refine representations over largely the same routing support. Motivated by this structure, we introduce WISE (Working-set Inference with Support Exploitation), a training-free method that uses unrestricted global attention during early recurrence and later reuses directly discovered block-structured support while keeping recurrent depth and within-support attention computation dynamic. Controlled interventions show that recurrent discovery is important and that support-only reuse better preserves model behavior than more restrictive attention-reuse alternatives. Across multi-hop QA benchmarks, WISE largely preserves full-attention performance, while context scaling reveals increasingly sparse working sets and greater efficiency gains. Quality is largely preserved through 2K context, with a measurable loss at 4K. An optimized sparse-attention implementation achieves up to a 1.76x attention speedup over native FlashAttention at 4K and a 1.36x speedup for the full 32-step attention trajectory. Our code is available at https://github.com/tbn5pj/WISE_code.

AI.tldr: 研究循环语言模型递归深度中的注意力动态，发现注意力支持比隐藏状态更早稳定；提出免训练方法WISE，早期用全局注意力发现工作集，后期复用块结构支持，在保持性能的同时提升效率。
AI.motivation: 标准推理在每个递归步骤都重新计算全局注意力，计算开销大。作者观察到注意力支持与分布远早于隐藏状态和注意力输出稳定，因此希望利用这种早期发现、后期复用的两阶段结构来加速推理。
AI.method: 分析跨递归深度的注意力动态；提出WISE：早期递归使用无限制全局注意力，后期复用直接发现的块状支持，同时保持递归深度和支撑内注意力计算动态；通过控制干预验证递归发现的重要性和支持复用的优势；在多跳QA基准上评估，并实现优化的稀疏注意力。
AI.result: WISE在多个多跳QA基准上基本保持全注意力性能；随着上下文扩展，工作集更稀疏、效率增益更明显；2K上下文质量基本保持，4K有可测损失；优化稀疏注意力在4K上相对原生FlashAttention实现最高1.76倍注意力加速，完整32步注意力轨迹为1.36倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 递归注意力可有效分解为早期发现稀疏工作集与后期复用路由支持两阶段；直接支持复用比更严格的注意力复用更能保持模型行为；WISE能在质量与效率间取得良好平衡，尤其适用于长上下文场景。

title: Planned Test-Time Scaling with Coordinated Reasoning Paths
summary: Test-time scaling with parallel branches is widely adopted to improve performance on challenging reasoning tasks. The predominant approach, repeated sampling, draws branches independently from a single policy, which can produce redundant attempts and thereby limit the gains from additional inference compute. To address this limitation, we propose Planned Test-Time Scaling (PTTS), which replaces independent sampling with a coordinated joint policy: a planner generates a solution outline for each branch, steering the branches toward distinct reasoning paths, and an executor produces a full solution conditioned on each outline. Formally, we show that PTTS strictly generalizes repeated sampling and, in a stylized setting, provably promotes coverage of complementary reasoning modes and yields better pass@k scaling. We instantiate PTTS on top of strong reasoning models, keeping them fixed as executors while replacing repeated sampling with PTTS inference to further enhance test-time scaling. Concretely, we develop two variants: PTTS-ZS prompts a model to jointly generate outlines for all branches in a single autoregressive pass, while PTTS-RL directly optimizes the planner against the pass@k reward using truncated execution rollouts for efficient training and a sharper reward signal. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks with Qwen3-1.7B and 4B, PTTS-ZS improves pass@64 over repeated sampling by up to 6.7 points, while PTTS-RL further increases the gain to up to 13.4 points. Further analysis indicates that broader coverage of distinct reasoning paths contributes to these gains. Overall, PTTS provides a general framework for improving test-time scaling by coordinating reasoning branches, with zero-shot and trainable instantiations that yield substantial performance gains.

AI.tldr: 提出计划式测试时扩展（PTTS），用规划器-执行器协同生成多样化推理分支，替代独立重复采样，从而提升测试时扩展性能。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时扩展常用重复采样，即从单一策略独立采样多个分支，容易产生冗余尝试，限制额外推理计算带来的性能增益。
AI.method: PTTS用规划器为每个分支生成解题大纲，引导分支走向不同推理路径，再由执行器根据大纲生成完整解。理论上证明PTTS严格泛化重复采样，并在简化设定中促进互补推理模式覆盖和更好的pass@k扩展。实例包括PTTS-ZS：单次自回归联合生成所有分支大纲；PTTS-RL：用截断执行轨迹和pass@k奖励直接优化规划器。
AI.result: 在五个数学推理基准上，使用Qwen3-1.7B和4B，PTTS-ZS将pass@64较重复采样提升最多6.7分，PTTS-RL进一步提升最多13.4分；分析表明增益来自更广泛地覆盖不同推理路径。
AI.conclusion: PTTS提供了一个通过协调推理分支来改进测试时扩展的通用框架，其零样本和可训练实例均带来显著性能提升。

title: Learn How to Act from Your Own Interactions: On-Policy Self-Distillation for GUI Agents
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents enable the fulfillment of complex user instructions through multi-turn interactions with software environments, requiring step-wise reasoning and long-horizon memory to guide actions and retain task-relevant information, respectively. Recent on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) methods have achieved strong performance on GUI grounding, a foundational subtask for GUI agents, owing to dense token-level supervision from privilege-conditioned self-teachers. However, extending existing OPSD methods to multi-turn GUI agents is hindered by self-teachers' limited privilege-following ability and insufficient privileged guidance. In this paper, we introduce GUI-SD-v2, the next version of GUI-SD, which extends OPSD from GUI grounding to multi-turn GUI interaction and addresses key limitations through a two-stage training framework. Specifically, GUI-SD-v2 first strengthens privilege following by jointly optimizing rollouts with and without privileged guidance from the same GUI states. Furthermore, it selectively distills step-specific reasoning and memory guidance through a privilege-conditioned self-teacher, supporting action decisions and the retention of task-relevant information for subsequent interactions. Extensive experiments on two representative GUI agent benchmarks, AndroidWorld and MobileWorld, show that GUI-SD-v2 compares favorably with existing OPSD baselines while consistently outperforming the evaluated state-of-the-art methods in both Pass@1 and Pass@3 success rates. Code and training data will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GUI-SD-v2，将在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）从 GUI grounding 扩展到多轮 GUI 交互，通过两阶段训练框架提升自教师的特权跟随能力，并选择性蒸馏步骤级推理与记忆指导，从而改进多轮 GUI 智能体的动作决策与任务相关信息保留。
AI.motivation: 现有 OPSD 方法在 GUI grounding 上表现优异，但将其扩展到多轮 GUI 智能体时，面临自教师特权跟随能力有限以及特权指导不足的问题，难以支持逐步推理和长时程记忆。
AI.method: 提出两阶段训练框架 GUI-SD-v2：第一阶段在同一 GUI 状态下联合优化有特权指导和无特权指导的 rollout，以增强特权跟随能力；第二阶段通过特权条件自教师，选择性蒸馏步骤特定的推理与记忆指导，用于支持动作决策和后续交互中任务相关信息的保留。
AI.result: 在 AndroidWorld 和 MobileWorld 两个代表性 GUI 智能体基准上，GUI-SD-v2 与现有 OPSD 基线相比具有竞争力，并在 Pass@1 和 Pass@3 成功率上持续优于所评估的当前最优方法。
AI.conclusion: GUI-SD-v2 成功将 OPSD 从 GUI grounding 扩展到多轮 GUI 交互，验证了所提两阶段训练框架的有效性。代码和训练数据将公开。

title: StateComp: Learning When to Compress History in Long Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents continuously accumulate interaction history during task execution, yet the importance of past interactions changes as the agent state evolves. Existing context management methods largely compress history based on fixed windows, periodic schedules, or current relevance, overlooking a more fundamental question: when has a past interaction become safe to replace? Premature compression may remove information still needed for future actions, while overly conservative retention leads to substantial context overhead. To address this, we propose State Conditioned Compression (StateComp), a framework that determines when historical interactions can be safely compressed according to the current agent state. StateComp constructs KEEP and READY supervision through a two-stage annotation procedure and trains an imbalance-aware router on hidden representations from a frozen language model. A bounded state representation further reduces the cost of evaluating long histories, while adjacent READY interactions are grouped into continuous spans and replaced with compact summaries during execution. Experiments on WorkBuddyBench show that StateComp reduces total agent and summarization tokens by 52.27% while maintaining task performance, and achieves a 12.67-fold speedup in representation extraction.

AI.tldr: 提出StateComp框架，根据当前智能体状态判断历史交互何时可安全压缩，在WorkBuddyBench上减少52.27%的token并保持任务性能，表示提取加速12.67倍。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体在执行任务中不断累积交互历史，但历史交互的重要性随智能体状态变化。现有上下文管理方法多基于固定窗口、周期调度或当前相关性进行压缩，忽略了更根本的问题：过去交互何时才可安全替换？过早压缩可能删除未来仍需的信息，过度保留则导致大量上下文开销。
AI.method: StateComp通过两阶段标注构建KEEP和READY监督信号，在冻结语言模型的隐藏表示上训练不平衡感知路由器；采用有界状态表示降低长历史评估成本；将相邻READY交互分组为连续片段，并在执行时替换为紧凑摘要。
AI.result: 在WorkBuddyBench上，StateComp将总智能体和摘要token减少52.27%，同时保持任务性能，并在表示提取上实现12.67倍加速。
AI.conclusion: StateComp能够根据智能体状态安全压缩历史交互，显著降低上下文开销且不损失任务性能，为长时程智能体的上下文管理提供了有效方案。

title: Stable Geometry with Divergent Task Evidence for Efficient Long-Horizon Agent Compression
summary: Long horizon agents accumulate growing interaction histories that increase context and inference costs. We find that geometric redundancy alone is an insufficient criterion for safe compression. Although agent histories exhibit strong low dimensional structure, similar global geometry can preserve very different amounts of task evidence. At identical retained block counts, evidence aware selection raises next action Top 3 retention from 0.31 to 0.69, while centroid similarity remains 0.98. Controlled replacement further shows that action related information can be substantially altered while global geometric measures remain nearly unchanged. Motivated by this gap between geometry and evidence, we introduce Geometry Guided Evidence Preserving Memory (GEM), a training free compressor that protects task and execution evidence before using geometric residuals to complete coverage. GEM reduces mean combined token usage from 2.69M to 2.11M per task, a 21.4% reduction, while maintaining comparable task reward. Our results show that efficient agent history compression should optimize for preserved task evidence rather than geometric coverage alone.

AI.tldr: 长时程智能体的交互历史不断增长，推高上下文与推理成本。研究发现仅凭几何冗余不足以安全压缩，提出免训练压缩器GEM，优先保留任务与执行证据，再用几何残差补全覆盖。
AI.motivation: 智能体历史虽有强低维结构，但相似的全局几何可保留差异极大的任务证据：相同保留块数下，证据感知选择将下一动作Top-3保留率从0.31提升至0.69，而质心相似度仍为0.98；受控替换也显示动作相关信息可大幅改变而全局几何几乎不变。
AI.method: 提出几何引导证据保留记忆（GEM），一种免训练压缩器：先保护任务与执行证据，再利用几何残差完成覆盖。
AI.result: 每任务平均合并token使用量从2.69M降至2.11M，减少21.4%，同时任务奖励保持相当。
AI.conclusion: 高效的智能体历史压缩应优化所保留的任务证据，而非仅追求几何覆盖。

title: Cross-Lingual Legal QA for Vietnamese Labour Law: Retrieval, Translation, and Verifier-Guided Correction
summary: Cross-lingual legal question answering must retrieve statutes across languages while preventing unsupported legal claims. We introduce a bilingual evaluation suite of 231 Vietnamese--English question--answer pairs from Vietnamese labour law. Of these, 75 are additionally annotated for five challenging legal reasoning phenomena. We evaluate a verifier-guided pipeline that decomposes answers into claims, checks citation reachability and entailment, and corrects citation failures and contradictions. We also introduce six automatic diagnostics for faithfulness to retrieved evidence, covering citations, modality, exceptions, procedures, conclusions, and evidential support. Experiments show that learned-sparse retrieval performs poorly for English-to-Vietnamese retrieval (R@5~=~0.032), whereas dense retrieval reaches 0.358 and slightly outperforms hybrid retrieval. Translation placement has no statistically detectable effect on these automatic diagnostics in our controlled comparison and supporting sensitivity analyses. Verifier-guided correction improves citation preservation by $0.022$--$0.034$ at the system level but produces no reliable gains in the remaining dimensions. Human evaluation further shows that the automatic diagnostics do not fully align with human judgements of answer quality.

AI.tldr: 提出越南语-英语法律问答双语评测集，评估验证器引导的检索问答流程与自动诊断。结果显示稠密检索明显优于稀疏检索，验证器引导纠正仅提升引用保持，自动诊断与人工判断不完全一致。
AI.motivation: 跨语言法律问答需要跨语言检索法条，同时必须防止模型提出缺乏依据的法律主张，因此需要专门的评测数据和忠实验证方法。
AI.method: 构建包含231个越南语-英语劳动法问答对的评测集，其中75个额外标注五类法律推理现象；采用验证器引导流程，将答案分解为主张，检查引用可达性与蕴含关系，并纠正引用失败和矛盾；设计六项自动诊断，覆盖引用、情态、例外、程序、结论和证据支持；进行受控实验、敏感性分析和人工评估。
AI.result: 英语到越南语检索中，学习稀疏检索表现较差，R@5约为0.032；稠密检索达到0.358，并略优于混合检索。翻译位置在自动诊断上没有统计可检测影响。验证器引导纠正使系统级引用保持提升0.022至0.034，但其余维度没有可靠增益。人工评估表明自动诊断与人工答案质量判断并未完全对齐。
AI.conclusion: 验证器引导纠正可改善引用可靠性，但不足以全面提升法律问答的忠实性；现有自动诊断与人工判断存在差距，跨语言法律问答评测仍需进一步完善。

title: PRISM-VLM: A Multi-Axis Discriminative Benchmark for Compact Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Findings. 29 pages, 22 figures, 21 tables
summary: Compact vision-language models (VLMs) now power a growing share of multimodal applications. The benchmarks used to compare them, however, inherit a frontier-centric design: each model is reduced to a single accuracy number, narrowing the inter-model gap on saturated suites and pressing models into low-score bands on harder ones. We introduce PRISM-VLM, a multi-axis discriminative benchmark that scores every item along seven axes covering the recurring failure modes (task quality, behavioral robustness, and capability bottlenecks) and combines them into a single PScore, with items recycled from fifteen public benchmarks. Across compact VLMs from the past two years, PScore separates model pairs more reliably than prior single-axis benchmarks under an item-level paired bootstrap, and surfaces behavioral differences these benchmarks average away. Even models with statistically indistinguishable PScores diverge sharply along the per-axis profile, particularly on sycophancy, which is nearly orthogonal to single-prompt accuracy. We will release the full pipeline, prompts, and per-item annotations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PRISM-VLM，一个面向紧凑型视觉语言模型的多轴判别性基准，用七个维度对每个样本评分并汇总为单一 PScore。
AI.motivation: 现有紧凑型 VLM 基准继承前沿模型中心设计，只给出单一准确率，导致模型间差异被压缩：在饱和数据集上区分度低，在较难数据集上又把模型挤入低分区间。
AI.method: 从十五个公开基准回收样本，对每个项目沿七个轴评分，覆盖任务质量、行为鲁棒性和能力瓶颈等常见失败模式，并合并为 PScore；采用项目级配对 bootstrap 进行评估。
AI.result: 在近两年的紧凑型 VLM 上，PScore 比先前单轴基准更可靠地区分模型对，并揭示被平均掉的行为差异；即使 PScore 统计上不可区分的模型，在各轴画像上也差异显著，尤其在谄媚性上，该维度与单提示准确率近乎正交。
AI.conclusion: 多轴判别性基准能更细致、可靠地比较紧凑型 VLM，行为维度提供单提示准确率无法覆盖的信息；作者将发布完整流程、提示和逐项标注。

title: AraGenre 2026: A Hierarchical Definition-Guided Arabic Genre Classification Shared Task
summary: AraGenre is a shared task on hierarchical, definition-guided Arabic genre classification, motivated by the limited availability of annotated data in Arabic and other low-resource languages. Systems assign each Arabic text segment both a broad communicative genre and a fine-grained specific genre. The released training and development sets contain limited, primarily synthetic and controlled examples, whereas the hidden final benchmark contains noisier naturally occurring text spanning Modern Standard Arabic, Classical Arabic, and multiple dialects. Participants received natural-language definitions for 74 previously unseen specific genres, creating a zero-shot label generalisation setting in which systems had to infer class semantics rather than memorise fixed label-feature associations. The task attracted 46 registrations and 373 submissions, with 17 teams completing the final evaluation. Thakaa ranked first with a Hierarchical Macro F1 of 0.7352, followed by HoangPhong (HP) with 0.7169 and NAMAA with 0.7013. The results show strong broad-genre recognition but a substantial gap in fine-grained classification under linguistic and domain variation.

AI.tldr: AraGenre 是一个阿拉伯语层级体裁分类共享任务，要求系统在零样本设置下，根据自然语言定义将文本同时分类为宽泛交际体裁和细粒度具体体裁。最终 17 支队伍完成评测，最佳系统取得 0.7352 的层级宏 F1。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语等低资源语言缺乏标注数据，且体裁分类需要适应未见细粒度标签、语言变体和自然噪声文本。
AI.method: 构建层级、定义引导的阿拉伯语体裁分类共享任务；训练/开发集有限且主要为合成受控样本，隐藏测试集为更嘈杂的自然文本，涵盖现代标准阿拉伯语、古典阿拉伯语和多种方言；提供 74 个未见具体体裁的自然语言定义，形成零样本标签泛化设定。
AI.result: 任务共有 46 个注册、373 次提交，17 支队伍完成最终评测。Thakaa 以层级宏 F1 0.7352 排名第一，HoangPhong 为 0.7169，NAMAA 为 0.7013。宽泛体裁识别较强，但细粒度分类在语言和领域变化下仍有明显差距。
AI.conclusion: AraGenre 表明零样本层级阿拉伯语体裁分类中，粗粒度体裁识别较可行，但细粒度、跨方言和噪声场景下的分类仍具挑战，需要更鲁棒的低资源方法。

title: Finite-Sample Probabilistic Safety Certification for AI-Based Grid-Edge Coordination
summary: Coordinating large population of flexible grid-edge devices can alleviate the need for time-consuming and capital-intensive network upgrades, and AI-based control methods such as multi-agent reinforcement learning or imitation learning are promising in their real-time decision scalability. However, system operators still need an independent and rigorous way to decide whether a given AI system is safe enough for deployment. This paper develops a finite-sample probabilistic safety certification framework for black-box AI decision models in closed-loop grid operation. The central idea is to reduce the complete input--AI--grid evaluator workflow to a binary unsafe outcome under an operator-defined safety specification, and then use exact binomial inference to certify the corresponding unsafe operation probability. Given a set of held-out calibration scenarios, the framework returns the tightest one-sided upper certificate and an accept/reject deployment criterion that controls the probability of false safety certification. Because the certification is for the calibration distribution that may deviate from the future operation, we further combine the nominal certificate with physically interpretable sample-space adversarial attacks, a concept widely used in AI to investigate the fragility of AI models. Case studies on grid-edge flexibility coordination with 1{,}000-agent AI models (independent parameters) verify the finite-sample safety guarantee and the value of integrating adversarial attacks into a rolling-window training-certification-deployment flow.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向闭环电网运行中黑盒AI决策模型的有限样本概率安全认证框架，并将该框架用于大规模电网边缘灵活性协调场景。
AI.motivation: 大规模灵活电网边缘设备协调可减少耗时且资本密集的电网升级，但系统运营商仍需独立且严格的方法来判断AI系统是否足够安全、可否部署。
AI.method: 将“输入—AI—电网评估器”完整工作流根据运营商定义的安全规范简化为二元不安全结果，利用精确二项推断认证不安全运行概率；基于留出校准场景返回最紧的单侧上界证书，并给出控制误认证安全概率的接受/拒绝部署准则；进一步结合具有物理可解释性的样本空间对抗攻击，以应对校准分布与未来运行分布可能偏离的问题。
AI.result: 在包含1000个独立参数智能体的电网边缘灵活性协调案例中，验证了有限样本安全保证的有效性，以及将对抗攻击纳入滚动窗口“训练—认证—部署”流程的价值。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可为黑盒AI决策模型提供独立、严格的概率安全认证，支持电网运行中的部署决策，并通过对抗攻击增强对分布偏移的鲁棒性。

title: When Parallel Drafter Meets Parallel Speculative Decoding
summary: DSpark-style parallel drafters have made speculative decoding highly effective, yet their draft phase remains serialized on the critical path of every round. Parallel speculative decoding (PSD) overlaps drafting with verification, yet existing methods must guess the accepted prefix and bonus token in advance: a wrong guess reverts the whole batch to serial drafting. We present DPara, a PSD framework that reuses effective parallel drafters yet guarantees backbone--verification overlap in every round, thereby eliminating this probabilistic fallback altogether. While the target verifies, DPara's diffusion backbone precomputes draft representations for every acceptance boundary with the bonus left unspecified; a lightweight autoregressive head then combines the revealed verification outcome with the matching precomputed representation to emit the next round's draft tokens almost instantly---fully parallelizing the dominant backbone forward with verification and leaving only the negligible head cost serial. Experiments on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B across seven math, coding, and chat benchmarks show that DPara achieves average speedups of $3.21\times$ and $3.52\times$ over autoregressive decoding, surpassing the strongest serial and parallel speculative decoding baselines alike.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DPara，一种并行投机解码（PSD）框架。它复用高效的并行草稿器，同时保证每一轮中主干网络的草稿计算与目标模型验证完全重叠，彻底消除了以往 PSD 方法中因猜错接受前缀而回退到串行草稿的概率性问题。
AI.motivation: DSpark 类并行草稿器虽有效，但草稿阶段仍串行位于每轮关键路径上。现有并行投机解码（PSD）虽将草稿与验证重叠，却必须预先猜测被接受前缀与奖励 token，一旦猜错，整批就会退化为串行草稿，存在概率性回退问题。
AI.method: DPara 在目标模型验证期间，利用扩散主干为每一个可能的接受边界预计算草稿表示（奖励 token 留空）；验证结果揭示后，一个轻量级自回归头将验证结果与对应的预计算表示结合，几乎瞬时生成下一轮草稿 token。由此，占主导成本的主干前向与验证完全并行，仅剩成本极小的头部件串行执行。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-8B 与 Qwen3-14B 上，针对数学、编程与对话共七个基准测试，DPara 相对自回归解码分别取得平均 3.21× 和 3.52× 的加速，并优于最强的串行与并行投机解码基线。
AI.conclusion: DPara 通过预计算各接受边界表示并配合轻量自回归头，实现了主干验证与草稿的确定性完全重叠，消除了概率性回退，在多个模型与任务上取得显著且稳定的加速效果。

title: Verifiable Hidden Dynamics Play: Generating Agentic RL Environments from Solved Mechanisms
summary: Language-model agents increasingly face long-horizon tasks with evolving state, interdependent decisions, and delayed outcomes. Scaling their training requires diverse agentic environments, dependable outcome signals, and low extension cost. Existing generation pipelines commonly construct an environment before defining its outcome rule or annotating its trajectories, leaving dynamics and evaluation to be aligned post hoc. VHD-Play reverses this dependency by sampling and solving a mathematical model before a corpus-grounded setter renders its decision process as stateful tools. The executable dynamics and trajectory-scoring reference are inherited from the same solved model. The pipeline produces 3,300 diverse agentic environments at a cost of a few cents each. Training Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on three families raises its mean agentic score from 0.204 to 0.815 in a five-family diagnostic. Gains also appear on held-out instances from all three training families and eight unseen mechanism families, then extend beyond the generated substrate to external benchmarks for general function calling, travel planning, and 365-day e-commerce. On E-Commerce Bench, the trained checkpoint completes every run without bankruptcy and exceeds Qwen3.7-Max. We compare written-out problems with stateful versions that reveal or hide their parameters. The comparison shows that most of the learnable gap lies in stateful interaction rather than underlying problem solving. A frozen 35B setter realizes larger environments, and scale-matched training retains gains as mechanism size and horizon grow, indicating the potential for an evolving training substrate.

AI.tldr: VHD-Play 反转环境构建流程，先采样并求解数学模型，再将其决策过程渲染为有状态工具，从而自动生成 3300 个智能体环境，每个成本仅几美分；用其训练 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 后，平均智能体得分从 0.204 提升至 0.815。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体正面临长时程任务，其状态不断演化、决策相互依赖且结果延迟。扩展这类训练需要多样化的智能体环境、可靠的结果信号和低扩展成本。现有生成流程通常先构建环境，再定义结果规则或标注轨迹，导致环境动态与评估只能事后对齐，效率低且难以扩展。
AI.method: VHD-Play 先采样并求解一个数学模型，再由基于语料库的设定器将其决策过程渲染为有状态工具。可执行动态与轨迹评分参考均继承自同一个已求解模型。该流程生成 3300 个多样化智能体环境，每个成本仅几美分。研究还训练 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，并对比书面问题与揭示或隐藏参数的有状态版本。
AI.result: 在五家族诊断中，训练后的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 平均智能体得分从 0.204 升至 0.815。增益也出现在三个训练家族的留出实例和八个未见机制家族上，并扩展到通用函数调用、旅行规划和 365 天电商等外部基准。在 E-Commerce Bench 上，训练后的检查点每次运行均未破产，且超过 Qwen3.7-Max。对比显示，大部分可学习差距在于有状态交互，而非底层问题求解。冻结的 35B 设定器可实现更大环境，规模匹配训练在机制规模和时程增长时仍保持增益。
AI.conclusion: VHD-Play 通过“先求解模型、再渲染为有状态工具”的方式，提供了动态与评估一致、低成本、可扩展的智能体训练环境生成方法，并显示出作为不断演化训练基底的潜力。

title: CART: Closed-Loop Adaptive Red Teaming for Large Language Models
summary: Automated red teaming often replays a fixed set of prompts, which measures known risks but cannot learn from failures found during testing. We present CART (Closed-Loop Adaptive Red Teaming), a framework that uses each result to guide what it tests next. CART begins with broad risk coverage, follows weaknesses that emerge, keeps new probes diverse, and records the evidence and source of every finding. It separates the Challenger that creates tests, the Target being tested, which may be a text-only model or a bounded tool-using agent, and the Judge that evaluates the results, allowing these roles to be studied independently. Across three evaluation families (Frontier, JAH, and Agentic), CART discovers more failures and higher average risk than static seed replay for every Target with an available baseline. The gains extend to tool-mediated agent tests, suggesting that contextual adaptation can reveal weaknesses that direct prompt replay does not exercise. These results describe what the test policies discover, not how often failures occur in real deployments. We also find that Challenger-Judge choices affect the evidence uncovered, highlighting the need for role separation and independent review. Overall, CART turns red teaming from a one-time checklist into a continuous, adaptive, and auditable search for model and agent weaknesses.

AI.tldr: CART 是一种闭环自适应红队测试框架，利用每次测试结果指导后续测试，旨在比静态固定提示复现发现更多模型与智能体弱点。
AI.motivation: 传统自动化红队测试通常重复固定提示集，只能衡量已知风险，无法从测试中发现的失败中学习并调整后续测试。
AI.method: CART 将流程分为 Challenger（生成测试）、Target（被测文本模型或受限工具使用智能体）和 Judge（评估结果），支持角色独立研究；策略包括广泛风险覆盖、追踪新出现的弱点、保持新探针多样性，并记录发现证据与来源。
AI.result: 在 Frontier、JAH 和 Agentic 三个评估族中，CART 对所有有可用基线的 Target 都比静态种子复现发现更多失败且平均风险更高；增益也出现在工具介导的智能体测试中。Challenger-Judge 选择会影响所发现的证据，说明角色分离与独立审查的必要性。
AI.conclusion: CART 将红队测试从一次性检查清单转变为持续、自适应且可审计的模型与智能体弱点搜索。

title: Uncheatable Eval: Dynamic Compression-Based Evaluation of Language Models
summary: Modern large language models are pretrained on massive datasets, making it difficult to prevent benchmark data from entering their training sets and undermining the reliability of evaluation results. Reliable evaluation is particularly challenging for base models, whose limited instruction-following ability complicates task-based assessment. We introduce Uncheatable Eval, a dynamic benchmark that regularly collects newly published text to evaluate base language models and reduce the risk of data contamination. Drawing on the relationship between a model's predictive ability and its ability to compress data losslessly, we use compression rate to evaluate how well models predict new text. We evaluate 80 models across 14 text categories, study how compression changes with context length, and examine the correlation between compression rate and zero-shot MMLU accuracy. Our results yield three main findings: (1) compression performance follows a consistent scaling trend with model size; (2) attention-based, hybrid, and recurrent models differ in how their compression performance changes as more context becomes available; and (3) lower compression rates are strongly associated with higher zero-shot MMLU accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/Jellyfish042/uncheatable_eval.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Uncheatable Eval，一种通过定期收集新发布文本、利用压缩率评估基座语言模型预测能力，从而降低数据污染风险的动态基准。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型预训练数据规模巨大，基准数据可能混入训练集，导致评估结果不可靠；基座模型指令遵循能力有限，传统任务式评估尤其困难。
AI.method: 构建动态基准，定期收集新文本；基于预测能力与无损压缩能力的关系，用压缩率衡量模型对未见文本的预测效果；评估80个模型、14类文本，分析压缩率随上下文长度的变化，并考察其与零样本 MMLU 准确率的相关性。
AI.result: 主要发现三点：(1) 压缩性能随模型规模呈现一致的缩放趋势；(2) 基于注意力、混合和循环的模型在上下文增加时压缩性能变化不同；(3) 更低压缩率与更高零样本 MMLU 准确率强相关。
AI.conclusion: Uncheatable Eval 可作为降低数据污染风险的动态评估方法，压缩率能有效反映基座语言模型的预测能力，并与下游任务表现相关。

title: Alignment Inertia: Auditing the Durability of Training Data Influence Through Policy Override Resistance
summary: Platform operators increasingly rely on system prompts and fine-tuning to govern model behavior, yet it remains unclear how reliably these interventions override behavior inherited from prior training. We propose Override Success Rate (OSR) and alignment inertia to measure when operator interventions succeed or fail to change prior behavior. We evaluate zero-shot prompting and LoRA fine-tuning across Llama and Mistral in medical misinformation and hate speech. Alignment inertia persists across both models but varies by model, domain, and policy direction. Notably, in Mistral's restrictive hate-speech condition, LoRA increased inertia by 46.5 percentage points, showing that fine-tuning can reinforce rather than override prior behavior. We also use TRAK to test whether inertia is associated with weaker adaptation signals. TRAK achieves AUC of at least 0.85 in 7 of 8 conditions and outperforms model confidence, TF-IDF similarity, and embedding similarity as a predictor of inertia. These results provide an operator-facing audit of where prior training constrains downstream model governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Override Success Rate（OSR）和对齐惯性指标，用于衡量系统提示与 LoRA 微调能否可靠覆盖模型从先前训练继承的行为。在 Llama 和 Mistral 的医疗虚假信息与仇恨言论任务中，发现对齐惯性普遍存在且受模型、领域和政策方向影响，微调有时反而增强惯性，TRAK 可有效预测惯性。
AI.motivation: 平台日益依赖系统提示和微调来治理模型行为，但这些干预能否可靠覆盖模型在先前训练中形成的行为尚不清楚，因此需要面向运营者的审计指标来评估干预成功率与对齐惯性。
AI.method: 提出 Override Success Rate（OSR）和对齐惯性指标；在 Llama 和 Mistral 上评估零样本提示与 LoRA 微调，任务涵盖医疗虚假信息和仇恨言论；并使用 TRAK 检验惯性是否与较弱的适应信号相关，同时与模型置信度、TF-IDF 相似度和嵌入相似度进行比较。
AI.result: 对齐惯性在两个模型中均持续存在，但因模型、领域和政策方向而异。在 Mistral 的限制性仇恨言论条件下，LoRA 使惯性增加 46.5 个百分点，表明微调可能强化而非覆盖先前行为。TRAK 在 8 个条件中的 7 个达到至少 0.85 的 AUC，且作为惯性预测器优于模型置信度、TF-IDF 相似度和嵌入相似度。
AI.conclusion: 先前训练会约束下游模型治理，系统提示和微调并不总能可靠覆盖既有行为。结果提供了面向运营者的审计视角，表明需要关注对齐惯性，而 TRAK 可辅助识别此类风险。

title: MORSE: Multi-Context Ordering via Reverse Scoring for Evidence-Preserving Compression
summary: Likelihood-based context compression can account for cross-context redundancy through sequential scoring, but this makes compression outcomes sensitive to context order. We show that different permutations of the same context collection can produce markedly different evidence-retention outcomes under an unchanged compressor. We attribute this sensitivity to information preemption: earlier partially relevant contexts can absorb credit for shared information, suppressing the incremental score of later, stronger evidence carriers and increasing their risk of removal. Controlled pair-swap interventions directly support this mechanism by showing that evidence-first ordering substantially improves supporting-evidence survival. To address this problem, we introduce MORSE, a compression-aware method for evidence-preserving context ordering. MORSE applies a common reverse query-evidence principle to both individual contexts and compressed candidate outputs, using the former to construct an evidence-first anchor and the latter to guide compression-aware permutation selection. Across multi-hop QA benchmarks, compression procedures, budgets, and scoring models, MORSE consistently improves evidence preservation over static reverse ordering and compute-matched random search, with corresponding overall improvements in downstream QA. Our code is available at https://github.com/tbn5pj/MORSE_code.

AI.tldr: 基于似然的上下文压缩对上下文顺序敏感，存在信息抢占问题，导致后续强证据被抑制。本文提出MORSE，一种压缩感知的证据保留上下文排序方法，在多跳QA上提升证据保留和下游性能。
AI.motivation: 基于似然的上下文压缩虽能通过顺序评分处理跨上下文冗余，但压缩结果对上下文顺序敏感，同一组上下文的不同排列会导致证据保留结果差异显著，原因是信息抢占：较早的部分相关上下文会吸收共享信息的贡献，抑制后续更强证据的增量得分，增加其被移除的风险。
AI.method: 通过受控的成对交换干预验证信息抢占机制；提出MORSE，将反向查询-证据原则同时应用于单个上下文和压缩候选输出，前者构建证据优先锚点，后者指导压缩感知的排列选择。
AI.result: 不同排列会产生显著不同的证据保留结果；证据优先排序能大幅提高支持证据的存活率；在多跳QA基准、多种压缩流程、预算和评分模型下，MORSE在证据保留上持续优于静态反向排序和计算量匹配的随机搜索，并相应提升下游QA整体表现。
AI.conclusion: MORSE能有效缓解似然压缩中的顺序敏感性问题，通过证据优先排序提升证据保留，进而改善多跳QA等下游任务性能。

title: EviStreams: Human-in-the-Loop AI Data Extraction for Systematic Reviews in Medicine
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 System Demonstrations
summary: Systematic reviews underpin clinical guidelines, yet their data-extraction step is a major expert-labor bottleneck bound by a protocolized workflow: two reviewers extract each study independently, an adjudicator resolves disagreements, and the team keeps an auditable record of how every value was produced. Large language models can assist with extraction, but that assistance must fit established review protocols and preserve reproducibility. We present EviStreams, a live, open-source, no-code web platform that puts review teams in control of AI-assisted extraction at three key stages: program design (a structured decomposition approved before any code runs), field specification (typed field definitions calibrated from a pilot), and extracted predictions (reviewer-blinded dual review with adjudication). Working through a form builder, a domain expert defines typed fields rather than prompts, runs extraction over uploaded PDFs, inspects every value alongside the supporting passage it came from, and resolves a reviewer-blinded dual review into an auditable consensus export. An evaluation across four clinical corpora and three frontier model families, released with the system, shows that extraction quality is shaped far more by the field specification than by the choice of model. EviStreams is live at https://evistreams.com/demo and released under Apache-2.0.

AI.tldr: 介绍 EviStreams——一个开源、无代码的在线平台，用于系统综述中 AI 辅助的数据提取，使评审团队能控制方案设计、字段规范与双盲评审三个阶段，并发布了跨四个临床语料库和三个前沿模型族的评估。
AI.motivation: 系统综述是临床指南的基础，但数据提取是专家人力瓶颈，且需遵循协议化流程：两名评审独立提取、裁决者解决分歧、团队保留可审计记录。LLM 可辅助提取，但必须契合既定综述协议并保持可复现性。
AI.method: 构建 EviStreams 无代码 Web 平台，覆盖三个关键阶段：方案设计（运行前结构化分解并审批）、字段规范（基于试点校准的类型化字段定义）、提取预测（评审者盲态双重评审与裁决）。领域专家通过表单构建器定义类型化字段而非提示词，对上传 PDF 运行提取，查看每个值及其支持段落，并将盲态双评审解析为可审计的共识导出。评估使用四个临床语料库和三个前沿模型族。
AI.result: 提取质量受字段规范的影响远大于模型选择。
AI.conclusion: EviStreams 已上线（https://evistreams.com/demo），并以 Apache-2.0 许可发布。

title: ThaiTrees: Thai Syntactic Dependency Trees Across Domains
summary: Studying syntactic patterns in naturally occurring language requires a large parsed corpus, but manual annotation is costly and difficult to scale. Thai has a manually annotated dependency treebank for training and evaluating parsers, but lacks a large automatically parsed corpus for quantitative syntactic research. We present ThaiTrees, a 342M-token corpus drawn from news, Wikipedia, spoken transcripts, and social media. We develop a reproducible pipeline for cleaning, processing, and parsing Thai text under the Universal Dependencies framework. The resulting corpus makes grammatical relations searchable and supports the study of syntactic distributions. We release a frequency lexicon and CoNLL-U parses in machine-readable formats suitable for both AI-assisted and conventional programmatic analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了泰语大规模自动依存句法语料库ThaiTrees，包含3.42亿词元，覆盖新闻、维基百科、口语转写和社交媒体，并发布频率词典与CoNLL-U格式解析结果。
AI.motivation: 研究自然语言的句法模式需要大规模已标注语料库，但人工标注成本高且难以扩展。泰语虽有人工标注的依存树库用于训练和评估解析器，却缺乏大规模自动解析语料库以支持定量句法研究。
AI.method: 从新闻、维基百科、口语转写和社交媒体收集泰语文本，构建可复现的清洗、处理和解析流程，并在Universal Dependencies框架下进行依存句法解析。
AI.result: 构建了342M词元的ThaiTrees语料库，使语法关系可搜索，支持句法分布研究，并发布了频率词典和机器可读的CoNLL-U解析文件。
AI.conclusion: ThaiTrees为泰语定量句法研究提供了大规模自动解析资源，所发布数据适用于AI辅助分析和传统程序化分析。

title: BiCFlow-MER: Orchestrating Discriminative and Generative Multimodal Emotion Recognition via Conditional Transport
summary: In multimodal emotion recognition (MER), human affective states are inferred by integrating complementary cues from multiple modalities. In audio-text MER, affective cues are often entangled with speaker style and lexical content, while cross-modal disagreement further complicates how the evidence should be integrated. Under conventional discriminative fusion, multimodal evidence is compressed into a terminal prediction, with modality-specific cues and conflict information insufficiently preserved. In large generative affective models, by contrast, affective reasoning is typically embedded in language decoding, leaving emotion evidence implicit and difficult to verify in a structured space. To address these limitations, BiCFlow-MER (Bidirectional Conditional Flow for Multimodal Emotion Recognition) is proposed as a conditional-flow framework in which audio-text MER is formulated as generative evidence transport within a structured emotion space. Within BiCFlow-MER, emotion-oriented evidence is disentangled from speaker-style and lexical-content factors to construct a conflict-aware affective condition. Guided by this condition, each utterance is transported to an explicit emotion-space endpoint through a bidirectional rectified flow. Candidate emotions are jointly verified through adaptive prototype-cloud scoring of the transported endpoint and backward class-to-condition consistency with the original multimodal condition, enabling conflict-aware recognition. BiCFlow-MER is shown to outperform all compared methods across IEMOCAP, MELD, and the zero-shot CASE benchmark. By orchestrating discriminative recognition and generative evidence modeling through conditional transport, BiCFlow-MER defines a new MER paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BiCFlow-MER，将音频-文本多模态情感识别建模为结构化情感空间中的生成式证据传输，通过双向条件流实现冲突感知的情感识别。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态情感识别中，情感线索常与说话人风格和词汇内容纠缠，跨模态不一致也增加融合难度；传统判别式融合会压缩多模态证据，生成式大模型中的情感推理又隐含且难以验证。
AI.method: 提出 BiCFlow-MER 条件流框架：从说话人风格和词汇内容中解耦情感证据，构建冲突感知情感条件；以双向校正流将每句话传输到显式情感空间端点；结合自适应原型云评分与反向类别到条件一致性进行候选情感联合验证。
AI.result: BiCFlow-MER 在 IEMOCAP、MELD 以及零样本 CASE 基准上均优于所有对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过条件传输协调判别式识别与生成式证据建模，BiCFlow-MER 定义了一种新的多模态情感识别范式。

title: When Context Misleads: In-context Learning with Jurisdiction in Large Language Models
summary: In-Context Learning (ICL) has become a cornerstone of modern LLM deployment. However, existing ICL post-training methods have a critical blind spot: they excel at extracting patterns from demonstrations while often neglecting context authority, the ability to determine whether contextual information should govern the final answer. To benchmark this capability, we introduce FakeContextBench, which contains pseudoscientific claims across seven domains. Our evaluation of commercial and open-source models shows that large-scale pre-training alone is insufficient for reliable context-authority discrimination. Moreover, prevalent ICL fine-tuning methods can increase susceptibility to misleading context, reducing reality accuracy by up to 14.95 percentage points relative to the base model. To address this trade-off, we propose Jurisdiction In-Context Learning (J-ICL), a post-training framework that incorporates context validation into the training objective. Across four model backbones, J-ICL improves ICLEval by an average of 5.84 percentage points and reality accuracy by 9.20 points over the corresponding base models. It also raises the Reality Rate by an average of 18.09 points relative to MetaICL and Symbol Tuning. These results demonstrate that ICL capability and resistance to deceptive context can be improved together. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/peilin717/FakeContext-Bench.

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有上下文学习后训练方法偏重从示例中提取模式，却忽视判断上下文是否应主导答案的“上下文权威性”，并提出基准 FakeContextBench 和训练框架 J-ICL 来同时提升 ICL 能力与抵抗误导性上下文的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 ICL 后训练方法存在关键盲点：擅长从演示中提取模式，但常常忽略语境权威性，即无法判断上下文信息是否应决定最终答案。大规模预训练本身也不足以可靠区分上下文权威，而常见 ICL 微调方法反而会提高对误导性上下文的敏感性。
AI.method: 作者提出 FakeContextBench，包含七个领域的伪科学主张，用于评测模型的上下文权威判别能力。同时提出 Jurisdiction In-Context Learning（J-ICL）后训练框架，将上下文验证纳入训练目标。
AI.result: 评测显示，仅靠大规模预训练不足以可靠判别上下文权威；常见 ICL 微调方法会使模型对误导性上下文更敏感，相比基座模型现实准确率最多下降 14.95 个百分点。在四个模型骨架上，J-ICL 相比对应基座模型平均提升 ICLEval 5.84 个百分点、现实准确率 9.20 个百分点；相比 MetaICL 和 Symbol Tuning，平均提升 Reality Rate 18.09 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论是，ICL 能力与抵抗欺骗性上下文的能力可以同时提升；通过将上下文验证纳入训练目标，模型能够在利用上下文信息的同时更好地判断其是否应主导答案。基准已开源于 https://github.com/peilin717/FakeContext-Bench。

title: Emergi-PersonaOS: A Persona Agent Operating System for Situational Adaptation and Controllable Evolution
summary: Symbiosis between humans and digital beings offers a vision for the future of human--machine interaction. In enduring human--machine relationships, personality provides a foundation for continuity of identity, individuality in interaction, and development through experience. We investigate this capacity through persona agents as computational implementations and introduce Emergi-PersonaOS, a psychology-grounded operating system for managing persona objects throughout their lifecycle. The system organizes dispositional traits, characteristic adaptations, and narrative identity into a three-layer persona representation, distinguishing relatively enduring persona beliefs from their activation in the current persona state. During situational adaptation, it integrates the current interlocutor, relationship, event, and retrieved memories to infer a persona state and generate actions and replies; during long-term development, it records experiences and outcomes, and develops and evaluates revision candidates through change attribution, meaning-making, and behavioral testing. Belief updates are managed through explicit review, traceable evidence and version records, and the ability to reject candidates, making persona evolution controllable. Using television-character dialogue as longitudinal material, we demonstrate long-horizon system operation and examine its principal mechanisms in a concrete implementation. This work provides a computational framework for persona agents to maintain individual continuity, produce situation-specific expression, and develop through experience over sustained interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出Emergi-PersonaOS，一个基于心理学的操作系统，用于管理人格代理的生命周期，实现持续交互中的人格连续性、情境化表达和通过经验发展。
AI.motivation: 为实现人类与数字体之间的共生，建立持久的人机关系，人格为身份连续性、交互个体性和经验发展提供基础。
AI.method: 通过人格代理作为计算实现，引入Emergi-PersonaOS系统；采用三层人格表示（性格特质、特征适应、叙事身份），区分持久人格信念与当前状态激活；情境适应中整合对话者、关系、事件和检索记忆推断人格状态并生成行动与回复；长期发展中记录经验和结果，通过变化归因、意义建构和行为测试开发评估修订候选；信念更新通过显式审查、可追溯证据和版本记录管理，并可拒绝候选。
AI.result: 使用电视剧角色对话作为纵向材料，展示了长期系统运行，并在具体实现中检验了其主要机制。
AI.conclusion: 为人格代理提供了一个计算框架，以维持个体连续性、产生情境特定表达，并在持续交互中通过经验发展。

title: State-Grounded Conditioning: Wrapping User-Facing LLM Agents Where Direction Depends on Live State
comment: 11 pages (6-page main body + Limitations, Ethics, References, Appendix); 4 figures; 3 tables. Preprint. Under review at EACL 2027 (Industry Track)
summary: We introduce State-Grounded Conditioning (SGC), a design principle for user-facing LLM agents that must condition on live user state (game state, session history, live inventory), and a distinct failure class we call direction drift: task-complete responses whose chosen direction misaligns with the current state. SGC externalises state-dependent control into rule kernels over structured inputs and three primary state slices, via Perception, Grounding, and Interaction wrappers with explicit conditioning dependencies. We evaluate SGC on a 200-session anonymised benchmark ($\approx$1,000 assistant model turns) from an in-game conversational coaching agent that guides players through consecutive competitive matches, reporting mean first-token latency and five human-annotated dialogue-quality metrics that jointly cover factual grounding and coach-like guidance progression. The Perception wrapper holds mean first-token latency at 1.5s (vs. 6.1s for PE-Agent inside a production tool-use harness); enabling all three wrappers lifts turn-level grounded accuracy from 61.1%/69.8% (Prompting / PE-Agent) to 96.7% and session-level grounded accuracy from 20.0%/26.5% to 83.5%; session-level grounding-failure incidents drop by $\approx$78% relative to the strongest baseline. A cumulative ablation shows complementary incremental gains as the wrappers are added. These results inform approximate state-slice orthogonality, without establishing independent per-wrapper effects.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向用户型LLM智能体的状态接地条件化设计原则SGC，用于解决响应方向与实时用户状态不一致的“方向漂移”问题，并在游戏内对话教练基准上验证其能显著提升接地准确率并降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 用户型LLM智能体需要依据实时用户状态（如游戏状态、会话历史、实时库存）进行条件化响应，但常出现任务完成却方向错误的失败，即方向漂移。
AI.method: SGC将状态相关控制外置为基于结构化输入和三个状态切片的规则内核，并通过Perception、Grounding、Interaction包装器及显式条件依赖实现。在200个匿名会话、约1000个助手回合的游戏内连续比赛教练基准上评估，报告首token延迟和五项人工标注对话质量指标。
AI.result: Perception包装器将平均首token延迟保持在1.5秒，优于生产工具调用框架中PE-Agent的6.1秒；启用三个包装器后，回合级接地准确率从Prompting的61.1%和PE-Agent的69.8%提升至96.7%，会话级从20.0%和26.5%提升至83.5%；会话级接地失败事件相对最强基线下降约78%；累积消融显示各包装器带来互补增量收益。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持近似状态切片正交性的观点，但尚未确立各包装器的独立效应；SGC为依赖实时用户状态的LLM智能体提供了一种有效设计原则。

title: Not What You Meant: Can LLMs Follow a Specified Negation Semantics?
summary: Negation does not carry a uniform interpretation across domains. In legal, regulatory, and medical reasoning, the intended interpretation depends on the reading in force -- open- versus closed-world, two- versus three-valued, and credulous versus skeptical. We study which reading of negation large language models adopt by default and whether they can override that preference when a different reading is explicitly specified. To this end, we introduce NAFBench, a procedural generator of solver-certified instances spanning four semantic viewpoints: SLDNF, well-founded semantics (WFS), and credulous and skeptical reasoning under stable-model semantics. The generator emits ground normal logic programs with controlled depth, width, and cycle structure. Each program is solved under all four viewpoints using SWI-Prolog, a well-founded semantics solver, and clingo, yielding up to four divergent labels. The programs are then verbalized into natural language under multiple framings and rule orderings that leave the answer invariant. The results expose a consistent gap. Across open-source models, following a specified negation semantics remains unsolved: the strongest models score 59--74% across the four semantic viewpoints, while the weakest score 31--67%. All models are order-sensitive on more than half of logically identical rule shufflings, while the two weaker models frequently overcommit on well-founded "undefined." Two frontier models reach 100% on the main fixed-complexity evaluation set, and a third, o4-mini, is near-perfect, falling only to 81% on well-founded "undefined." Delegating reasoning to a solver, fine-tuning on certified traces, or forcing an explicit three-valued verdict each partly closes the gap.

AI.tldr: 论文提出NAFBench，用求解器认证的基准测试大语言模型默认采用何种否定语义，以及能否按指定语义覆盖默认偏好。结果显示模型在四种语义视角下仍有明显差距，尤其开源模型和规则顺序扰动下表现不稳定。
AI.motivation: 否定在法律、监管和医疗等推理中没有统一解释，其含义取决于开放/封闭世界、二值/三值、轻信/怀疑等不同语义约定。作者关注大语言模型默认采用哪种否定读法，以及能否在明确指定不同语义时正确切换。
AI.method: 构建NAFBench程序化生成器，生成受控深度、宽度和循环结构的地面正规逻辑程序，并用SWI-Prolog、WFS求解器和clingo在SLDNF、良基语义、稳定模型语义下的轻信与怀疑推理四种视角求解，得到最多四种不同标签。随后将程序在多种框架和规则顺序下自然语言化，且保证答案不变，以测试模型对否定语义和顺序扰动的敏感性。
AI.result: 模型普遍存在语义遵循差距：开源模型最强仅59–74%，最弱31–67%；所有模型在超过一半逻辑等价的规则重排中表现顺序敏感，两个较弱模型常对良基语义中的“undefined”过度断言。两个前沿模型在主固定复杂度评测集上达100%，o4-mini接近完美，仅在良基“undefined”上降至81%。将推理委托给求解器、在认证轨迹上微调或强制显式三值判定，均可部分缩小差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前大语言模型尚不能可靠遵循指定的否定语义，尤其开源模型在语义切换、顺序稳定性和三值“未定义”处理上存在系统缺陷。外部求解器、认证数据微调和显式三值输出是有前景的部分补救方向。

title: MWE-ECL: Recoverable Long-Range Context Does Not Always Override Local Lexical Priors
summary: Long-context evaluations often test whether a model can recover distant evidence, but recoverability does not guarantee behavioral influence.
